name: Enos
description: The Enos Surgical System (formerly SPORT) is a single-access robotic surgical platform developed by Titan Medical for minimally invasive abdominal and gynecological surgery. The system was designed around a patient cart with a multi-articulated insertion boom that delivers two snake-like articulating instruments and a high-definition 3D camera through a single 25 mm incision, operated from an open ergonomic surgeon workstation. Development of the platform was paused in 2023 when Titan Medical initiated a strategic process and licensed its robotic surgery patent portfolio to Intuitive Surgical.
